name: Rat
habit: Small and quick. Darts in, bites, darts off.
fun: There is never just one. If you see one rat, there are six rats, and one of them is behind you.

name: Slime
habit: Hops at you and lands on you: the landing is its blow. Up in a hop, nothing on the floor touches it. Splits into slimelets when it dies.
fun: Mostly water, partly floor, slightly whoever it ate last week. Hit it hard enough and you get two smaller problems.

name: Slimelet
habit: Weak alone, annoying in a crowd. Quick little hops.
fun: A slime's children. They take after their parent: wobbly, sticky, unbothered.

name: Skeleton
habit: Winds up a heavy swing. Cold bites it; poison barely takes.
fun: Got up one day and simply never stopped. Doesn't know why it fights. Fights anyway.

name: Bone King
habit: Slams the ground.
fun: An older Bone King, from before the crown fit.

name: Wolf
habit: Circles, then lunges. Its howl turns the whole pack onto one hero.
fun: Never alone, never quiet about it. If one howls, count the trees and assume each one is a wolf.

name: Rattler
habit: A plain bony fighter. Shrugs off poison; cold bites it.
fun: You hear it a room away. Every step sounds like someone dropping a box of spoons.

name: Bone Archer
habit: Keeps its distance and shoots.
fun: Lost its jaw, kept its aim. Still holds a grudge about the jaw.

name: Bone Spear
habit: Pokes from further away than you'd like.
fun: Has a spear and the reach to prove it. Thinks the front line is a personality.

name: Loose Jaw
habit: Heavy blows that knock heroes back.
fun: The jaw hangs by a thread and the mace hangs by a grudge. Both swing.

name: Gaper
habit: Charges through a line with its swords in a V, then spins.
fun: Mouth open since the day it died. Nobody has had the heart to tell it.

name: Brute
habit: Big, slow, hits like a falling door.
fun: Built like a wardrobe someone filled with bones and anger.

name: Ghost
habit: Floats up close; its touch makes you drowsy, and enough of it puts you to sleep. Poison does nothing to it, fire does plenty.
fun: Somebody's great-great-grandmother. She did not like your boots.

name: Lizardman
habit: A spear with reach, and a tail it whips round in a spin. Cold slows it.
fun: Cold-blooded, warm-hearted, sharp-speared. Likes long walks in damp tunnels.

name: Lizard Blade
habit: Darts in with blades, slips back out.
fun: The quick one of the family. Has never once waited its turn.

name: Goblin
habit: Fast and flimsy. Gangs up on whoever is alone.
fun: Three goblins in a coat would still be shorter than you. They come in fives.

name: Hobgoblin
habit: A tougher goblin with a proper weapon.
fun: A goblin who ate its greens. Every single one of them.

name: Orc
habit: Hits hard and takes a beating.
fun: Loud, proud and mostly shoulders. Settles every argument the same way.

name: Orc Shaman
habit: Hangs back and lobs fireballs that burst and burn.
fun: Shakes a stick with feathers on it, then throws fire. The feathers are mostly for show.

name: Troll
habit: Huge and slow. Left alone, it grows back what it lost, unless it has been burned.
fun: Heals faster than you can be rude to it. Very rude, very fast.

name: Grave Warden
habit: Guards the way down. Heavy, patient, cruel.
fun: Keeps the crypt's keys and the crypt's rules. Rule one: nobody leaves.

name: Lizard Chief
habit: A warden: quick and brutal.
fun: Wears the biggest blade and the smuggest face in the drains.

name: Orc Warboss
habit: A warden: shouts, charges, smashes.
fun: Became boss the orc way: by being the last one standing in the room.

name: The Bone King
habit: The last boss. Calls his dead, slams, sweeps the room.
fun: He was a king once. Now he is mostly crown. He would like his kingdom back, and yours too.

name: Succubus
habit: Every few seconds she answers a blow with a kiss that charms whoever struck it. She goes for the charmed and hits them harder, and every so often blows a kiss at whoever is closest to falling for her: a hero charmed full up fights for her for a while, and one half charmed cannot bring itself to hit her.
fun: Has a lovely smile, and she knows it. So, before long, will you.

name: Pit Lord
habit: A whip of fire down a line, rifts near the party that spit imps, a ring of fire, and a slam.
fun: Runs the pit like a foreman runs a building site, except with more whips and fewer breaks.

name: Dire Wolf
habit: Pounces from far off and pins whoever it lands on.
fun: The wolf other wolves tell stories about. The stories end with someone being sat on.

name: Big Slime
habit: Spits slime balls. Bursts into two slimes, which burst into slimelets.
fun: What a slime becomes if you leave it alone long enough. Nobody has left one alone long enough to see what comes next.

name: Poison Slime
habit: Its touch poisons, and its splitting leaves a cloud of poison behind. Poison does nothing to it.
fun: Glows a cheerful lime green. The cheer is a lie.

name: Poison Slimelet
habit: Its touch poisons.
fun: Small, green and very keen to share.

name: Orange Goblin
habit: Half again as fast as a goblin; darts in, strikes, darts out, never still.
fun: Ate something orange once and never slowed down again.

name: Bandit
habit: Sword and shield: blocks from the front and bashes you back.
fun: Your money or your life. Mostly your money. Then your life, out of habit.

name: Torch Bandit
habit: Its blows singe, and it sweeps the torch round in a burst of fire.
fun: Brought a torch to a sword fight. It is working out better than you would think.

name: Greatsword Bandit
habit: Slow, wide swings, and a whirling sweep all round.
fun: Compensating for something. The something is a very long sword.

name: Axe Bandit
habit: Heavy, staggering chops, and it throws the axe at anyone a little way off.
fun: Believes every problem is a log. You are now a log.

name: Spear Bandit
habit: A reaching thrust and a lunge, spear first.
fun: Likes to keep strangers at arm's length. Its arm is very long.

name: Knife Bandit
habit: Quick and slippery: cuts that poison, then gone.
fun: Two knives, no manners. The knives are poisoned; the manners never were.

name: Poacher
habit: A bow, and a net now and then that holds you fast.
fun: Hunts anything that moves. You moved.

name: Bandit Brute
habit: A slow wind-up slam that sends heroes flying.
fun: Wears a bear. Nobody asks what happened to the bear.

name: Thornback Boar
habit: Charges in a straight line. Running into a wall or a rock dazes it.
fun: Has exactly one idea and is very committed to it.

name: Sproutling
habit: Darts in for a short jab. Left alone, it roots and turns into a little turret.
fun: A tree's idea of a child. Cute, until it puts its roots down and starts spitting.

name: Ent
habit: Roots burst up in a line that entangles. Hit it hard and a sproutling falls off. Fire bites it.
fun: Slow to anger. Slower to calm down. Has been angry since the last war, and the one before.

name: Wisp
habit: Mends the beasts near it and blinks away from danger. Kill it first.
fun: A light in the wood that leads travellers astray. It leads wolves to the travellers.

name: The Alpha
habit: A mini-boss. Calls the pack, howls them faster, pounces and pins, rends up close.
fun: The pack's whole opinion, in one wolf.

name: The Bandit Chief
habit: A mini-boss. Whistles up his gang or a wolf, throws knives in a fan, and vanishes in smoke to come out elsewhere.
fun: Runs the camp, the road and the protection racket. Mostly runs, when it suits him.

name: The Elder Ent
habit: The Wildwood's boss. Roots, root cages, falling branches, a grove that feeds it. Burning, it rampages: hits harder and faster, takes twice as much, and every blow burns.
fun: The oldest thing in the wood. It was here before the wood, and it remembers who cut the first tree.

name: Mouse
habit: Tiny, quick, nibbles. Comes with the goblins.
fun: A goblin's best friend. Goblins are not great friends.

name: Dynamite Mouse
habit: Runs up to you, fizzes, and blows.
fun: Somebody strapped a stick of dynamite to a mouse. The mouse is thrilled.

name: Spear Goblin
habit: Throws a spear that cuts on the way out and on the way back.
fun: Throws its spear and catches it again. Has dropped it only twice. Both times on its foot.

name: Goblin Bomber
habit: Lobs bombs that sit fizzing a moment before they blow.
fun: Red cap, short fuse, shorter life expectancy.

name: Suicide Bomber
habit: Runs up, stands next to you a moment, and explodes. Kill it quickly.
fun: Has a plan. The plan has one step. Kill it before the step.

name: Drummer
habit: Does no damage; everything near it attacks faster while it plays.
fun: Cannot fight, cannot sing, will not stop drumming.

name: Wolf Rider
habit: Charges through the party, spear first. When the wolf falls, the goblin fights on.
fun: Two bad tempers stacked one on the other.

name: Frost Shaman
habit: Frost balls that chill, and ice totems that freeze everyone near them.
fun: The orc shaman's cousin from up north. Brought the weather with him.

name: Ice Totem
habit: Chills everyone near it until it breaks or melts.
fun: A lump of ice with a face carved on it. The face is judging you.

name: Rock Troll
habit: Pushes a boulder before it. Rolls it at you, or charges behind it. The boulder can't be hurt.
fun: Rolls a boulder everywhere it goes. Has never once wondered why.

name: Plague Rat
habit: Its bite poisons; it bursts into a cloud of poison when it dies.
fun: Green, damp, and coughing. Do not let it sneeze on you.

name: Rat King
habit: Rats break loose from it as it's hurt, and three more when it dies.
fun: Ten rats with one idea, all of them knotted at the tail.

name: Sludge Slime
habit: Leaves oil when it dies. Burning, it moves twice as fast; dying burning, it leaves fire and no slimes.
fun: Half slime, half sump. Smells like a lamp that has given up.

name: Croc
habit: Chops with two axes; its bite holds a hero and drags them off. Hits wet heroes harder.
fun: Two axes and a smile with too many teeth in it.

name: Sewer Crab
habit: Comes in on wide circles, always facing you. Armoured in front.
fun: Walks sideways, thinks sideways, pinches straight ahead.

name: Blue Crab
habit: Circles in, and shoots slow bubbles that soak.
fun: The crab that brought bubbles to a fight.

name: Green Crab
habit: Circles in, and shoots poison bubbles two at a time.
fun: The bubbles are green. That is never good.

name: Blood Leech
habit: Latches on and drinks, drops off and spits the blood back as shots.
fun: Drinks deep, then gives it back, at speed.

name: Brain Leech
habit: Latches on and turns a hero on its friends. Their blows go to the leech; knock it off.
fun: Has opinions, and puts them in your head.

name: Golden Skeleton
habit: Golden bones home in on heroes and go through them. Nothing sticks to it: no status at all. Drops double gold.
fun: Buried with its treasure, and took that personally.

name: Harrowing Skeleton
habit: Gets up again once, with a burst of curse round it.
fun: Dies the way other people take a nap.

name: Scarab
habit: Burrows under the sand (a trail of dug-up earth) and comes up beside a hero. Comes in swarms.
fun: Rolls dung for a living. Has decided you are a career change.

name: Golden Scarab
habit: A tougher scarab. Nothing sticks to it: no status at all.
fun: Sacred, shiny and absolutely certain of it.

name: Cobra
habit: Spits poison from range, and rears back out of reach when you come close.
fun: Hood up, manners down.

name: Jackal Guard
habit: Spear and shield. Sidesteps your blow, then lunges back.
fun: Has guarded this door for three thousand years. Has opinions about visitors.

name: Mummy
habit: Slow. Its wrappings lash out and pull you in, and its touch curses. Fire loves it.
fun: Wrapped for eternity. Eternity is chafing.

name: Sand Mage
habit: Calls dust devils that spin off in straight lines, bowling heroes over and stopping shots.
fun: Talks to the wind. The wind answers, rudely.

name: Dust Devil
habit: Spins in a straight line, bounces off walls, throws whoever it hits. Blocks shots. Blows itself out.
fun: A small, angry weather.

name: Sand Serpent
habit: A head and a long body, one health: hit anywhere. It rears back, swaying, and strikes (a line shows first); its bite poisons and its coils hurt to touch. Now and then it dives into the sand, body and all, and comes up beside you: watch for the moving mound.
fun: Long enough to have a different mood at each end.

name: Serpent Coil
habit: A blow here lands on the head.
fun: Part of a snake. The rest of the snake is coming.

name: Dart Trap
habit: Set in a wall. Barely turns; fires poison darts at whoever crosses in front.
fun: The tomb's original security system. Still under warranty.

name: Venom Spirit
habit: Its ray makes a friend's blows poison, and poison can't touch it. Bursts into venom when it dies.
fun: Smells of old tombs and worse intentions.

name: Wind Spirit
habit: Its ray quickens a friend's feet and blows for as long as it holds.
fun: A breeze that never learned to slow down.

name: Gear Sprite
habit: Doesn't aim: rolls where it's going, straight through the party, and off the walls at a slant.
fun: A cog that came loose and liked it.

name: Cog Sprite
habit: Rolls and bounces like a gear sprite, but leans towards whoever is ahead of it.
fun: A gear sprite with a sense of direction. Unfortunately.

name: Bomb Bot
habit: Sees you, lights its fuse and runs straight at you; blows up when it runs out. Knock it back into its friends. Fire sets it off.
fun: Built to do one job, once.

name: Auto Bomb Bot
habit: If it misses, it puts its fuse out, turns slowly round and tries again. Fire sets it off.
fun: A bomb bot with a second opinion.

name: Automaton
habit: Hits hard; after three blows it overheats and stands open, taking more harm.
fun: Its makers gave it a sword and no off switch. Only one of those was a mistake.

name: Steam Turret
habit: Can't move, turns slowly, fires scalding steam that soaks. Get behind it.
fun: The kettle of your nightmares.

name: Flame Turret
habit: Can't move. Turns to whoever is close and blasts a short cone of flame.
fun: Fire safety was not a design goal.

name: Gun Turret
habit: Set in a wall: turns only so far, and fires a burst of rounds.
fun: Bolted to the wall and furious about it.

name: Laser Turret
habit: Set in a wall: a long line shows, then the beam burns down it.
fun: Points a red line at you, then a much worse one.

name: Mortar
habit: Can't move. Shells go up and come down where you were standing: a circle shows where.
fun: Lobs things over walls, which is cheating.

name: Fire Mortar
habit: Its shells leave the floor burning.
fun: Same mortar, extra spicy.

name: Gas Mortar
habit: Its shells leave a cloud of gas.
fun: Somebody filled the shells with the canteen's soup.

name: Tesla Coil
habit: Can't move. A shock jumps from hero to hero; far worse on anyone wet.
fun: Hums. You can feel it in your teeth.

name: Repair Drone
habit: Floats about mending constructs. Kill it first.
fun: Fixes everything except the actual problem, which is you.

name: Foundry Smith
habit: A red-hot hammer: every blow burns, and its slam sets the floor alight.
fun: Has hit a lot of metal into shape. Sees no reason you should be different.

name: Copper Bee
habit: Swarms. Zigzags in, then a long straight dash through you.
fun: A bee, but made of copper, and much less interested in flowers.

name: Copper Wasp
habit: Circles its mark, flicking short stingers.
fun: Circles. Waits. Stings. Repeats.

name: Copper Hornet
habit: Circles, then takes turns: five stingers, then a bee's dash.
fun: The wasp's big sister, and she is not happy.

name: Bronze Bee
habit: A tougher bee.
fun: The bronze model. Heavier, angrier, same lack of flowers.

name: Steel Bee
habit: The toughest bee.
fun: Steel. Polished. Furious.

name: Bronze Wasp
habit: A tougher wasp.
fun: A bronze wasp. The circling is somehow more smug.

name: Steel Wasp
habit: The toughest wasp.
fun: Steel wasp. Even the buzzing sounds sharp.

name: Bronze Hornet
habit: A tougher hornet.
fun: Bronze, and bigger, and still not happy.

name: Steel Hornet
habit: The toughest hornet.
fun: The foundry's finest. Mind the end with the point.

name: Saw Blade
habit: A trap: runs along a wall, half sunk in it, cutting whoever it meets. Can't be hurt; stops when the room is won.
fun: Runs along the wall all day. Never once looked where it was going.

name: Chain Crawler
habit: A head and eight plates, one health: hit anywhere. Lunges, and its bite shocks; its plates hurt to touch.
fun: A centipede somebody built on purpose. Nobody will say who.

name: Crawler Plate
habit: A blow here lands on the head.
fun: One of many legs. Kicks like all of them.

name: Drill Bot
habit: Drills under the floor and comes up spinning beside a hero.
fun: Digs for gold. Finds you. Close enough.

name: Storm Spirit
habit: Its ray makes a friend's blows shock, and shock can't touch it. Bursts with lightning when it dies.
fun: A thunderstorm the size of a teacup.

name: Frost Wolf
habit: Runs with the pack. Its bite chills; a few bites and a hero freezes solid.
fun: Its breath freezes in the air, and then it freezes you. It has never once been warm and holds it against everyone.

name: Ice Slime
habit: Where it lands after each hop the air goes freezing for a moment, and its touch chills. Shatters into ice shards when it dies.
fun: A slime that sat in the cold too long and decided it liked it.

name: Frost Spider
habit: Its bite chills, and the web it dies into chills whoever walks through.
fun: Spins its webs out of frost. They are beautiful. They are also a trap. Mostly a trap.

name: Yeti
habit: Pushes a heavy snowball before it, slow to get going and slow to turn, then runs it at you and lets it go (a line shows first): it bowls over whoever is in its way (heavy cold, a big shove) and bursts on a wall it hits hard. Shots knock the ball off course and chip it. Without one it fights with its fists (they stagger) and stoops to pack another; hit it hard while it packs and the snow falls apart.
fun: Has never seen a snowball fight it didn't win. Has never seen a snowball fight end.

name: Icicle Wraith
habit: Hangs back and drops icicles from above: a shadow shows where.
fun: Haunts the roof of the cave. Drops by now and then, sharply.

name: Frost Spirit
habit: Its ray lends a friend the cold: every blow chills, and cold can't touch it. Bursts into frost when it dies.
fun: A breath of winter that decided to help. It is not helping you.

name: Fire Spider
habit: Its bite burns, and it spits fireballs from a way off.
fun: Eight legs, all of them on fire, none of them bothered.

name: Hellhound
habit: Runs with the pack and leaves fire where it runs, and goes for whoever is doing the healing. Its bite bleeds; up close it breathes a short cone of flame.
fun: Good dog. Bad breath. Very, very bad breath.

name: Cinder Bat
habit: Dives straight at a hero and bursts into flame. Shoot it before it gets there.
fun: Lives fast, dies young, takes you with it.

name: Fire Spirit
habit: Its ray sets a friend's blows alight, and fire can't touch it. Bursts into flame when it dies.
fun: A spark with ambitions.

name: Fallen Angel
habit: An angel's spear, but its blows curse instead of blinding with light.
fun: Still has the wings. Lost the rest of the job description.

name: Sun Blade
habit: A great sword three heroes long. It turns onto a line (the floor shows the band it will sweep), cocks back and spins down it, cutting whoever its blade passes over, and drives its point into the wall at the end. Nothing stops or shoves it on the way. Stuck, it is open: blows land half again as hard until it works itself free.
fun: A sword so holy it doesn't need anyone to hold it. It finds that freeing.

name: Choir Sprite
habit: Everything of its side inside its song mends, and everyone of yours inside it grows sleepy. A stagger silences it for a while.
fun: Knows one song. It is a lovely song. It is the reason the others keep getting up.

name: Golem
habit: Slow and hard to shift. Every blow staggers, and it stamps a crack along the floor at you.
fun: Somebody carved a guard out of a hill and forgot to tell it the war was over.

name: Gilded Golem
habit: A golem whose front throws shots straight back at whoever fired them. Get round it.
fun: Gold all the way through. You would think that would make it softer. It does not.

name: Light Spirit
habit: Its ray mends a friend for as long as it holds. Kill it first.
fun: A little sunbeam with a job to do.

name: Ward Spirit
habit: Its ray takes half the harm off a friend for as long as it holds.
fun: Small, shy, and the reason that angel won't go down.

name: Herald of Light
habit: With its fallen twin: each mends while the other is near, so pull them apart. It blinks far off and calls light down on the party.
fun: One of a pair. Finishes its twin's sentences, and its twin's enemies.

name: Fallen Herald
habit: With its twin of light: each mends while the other is near. It charges clean across the room, and its gloom curses.
fun: The other one of the pair. Always the one who gets blamed.
